description: `expected` keys no SDK driver reads. EMPTY as of the 0.27 cycle: every top-level expectation in every fixture is asserted by at least one driver, and the two that are not assertable from a core SDK carry a reason and an expiry condition in expected_keys_allowlist.json. CI runs check_expected_keys_read.py --strict, so a new unasserted expectation cannot land. If an entry reappears here it is a deliberate, temporary exception that needs a reason next to it.
